exposure: intraoperative ultrasound measurements of the LUS thickness
preoperative ultrasound measurements of the lower uterine segment (LUS) thickness
outcome: thickness of the lower uterine segment
cohort: 33 women with a history of at least one cesarean delivery
finding: Intraoperative ultrasound was significantly better at predicting the presence of uterine scar tissue than preoperative ultrasound.
